text: {"features":[{"name":"Academic preparation","description":"How strong and advanced the letter's formal academic background is relative to the role's stated minimum and preferred qualifications.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Holds only the minimum bachelor's degree and presents it simply as a credential with no further academic depth."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Holds only a bachelor's degree but frames it as a meaningful technical foundation for demanding engineering work."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Holds a master's degree in a relevant technical field and presents it as part of the qualification case."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Holds a doctoral degree in a relevant technical field and uses it as evidence of advanced technical preparation."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Holds a doctoral degree and clearly positions it as especially relevant preparation for complex systems, security, or research-heavy engineering."}]},{"name":"Production delivery depth","description":"Extent to which the letter shows sustained experience testing, maintaining, and launching real software services.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Shows only near-minimum qualifying experience and relatively narrow service exposure, with limited sense of full lifecycle depth."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Shows a few years of relevant work and some production launches, but the scope or longevity still feels modest."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows solid professional depth through multiple years and several production services spanning testing, maintenance, and launch."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows substantial depth through sustained multi-year work and repeated launches of production systems."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows extensive, seasoned lifecycle experience across many services, making the applicant look ready for high-trust infrastructure work."}]},{"name":"Go backend fluency","description":"Strength of evidence that the candidate can design and implement the Go back-end systems central to the role.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Mentions Go only as one language among many, with no sign it is central to recent backend work."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Indicates working proficiency in Go but gives little evidence of depth or backend ownership."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows credible professional Go use on production services and back-end tasks."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Presents Go as a primary language for substantial backend or infrastructure work."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Demonstrates deep Go-centered backend experience directly relevant to security tooling, agent infrastructure, or core services."}]},{"name":"Python fluency","description":"Strength of evidence that the candidate can use Python effectively for automation, tooling, services, and AI agents.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Omits Python or gives no concrete sign of practical Python capability."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions Python briefly but leaves its depth or production use unclear."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows regular Python use for tooling, services, or automation in day-to-day work."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Demonstrates substantial Python depth through multiple use cases such as internal services, analysis tooling, or automation layers."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Presents Python as production-grade and central, with concrete evidence of service-quality code or agent implementations others depend on."}]},{"name":"Applied AI experience","description":"Extent to which the letter shows hands-on experience building and shipping AI or LLM-backed functionality responsibly.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Gives no evidence of AI experience."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Signals only limited or vague exposure to AI without production context."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows direct work with AI features or model integrations in practical engineering settings."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows production AI experience with attention to reliability, evaluation, or failure modes."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Demonstrates substantial AI implementation depth by pairing shipped model-backed systems with clear evidence of responsible deployment practices."}]},{"name":"Agent architecture experience","description":"Extent to which the letter shows design experience with agentic systems similar to the role's Python agents and Go infrastructure.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Gives no evidence of agentic tooling experience."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions agents in passing without explaining system design or constraints."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows credible experience building or integrating agent-based workflows."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Describes agent systems with clear architectural thinking, including task boundaries or orchestration patterns."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows end-to-end design of agentic systems, explicitly pairing capable agents with guardrails, auditing, permissions, or supervising infrastructure."}]},{"name":"Vulnerability automation experience","description":"Extent to which the letter shows direct experience automating vulnerability intake, triage, routing, or related response workflows.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Gives no evidence of vulnerability workflow automation."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Speaks generally about security automation but does not show hands-on work on vulnerability processes."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows some direct experience automating parts of vulnerability handling or report management."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Describes a concrete vulnerability triage or intake system that materially reduced manual work."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Presents vulnerability automation as a major accomplishment, with clear ownership of classification, routing, deduplication, or self-serve handling at meaningful scale."}]},{"name":"Security assessment depth","description":"Extent to which the letter demonstrates practical experience assessing systems for security weaknesses.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Gives no evidence of performing security assessments."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Implies some security review exposure but with little detail about methods or ownership."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows credible hands-on assessment work such as reviews, threat models, or attacker-minded code reading."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Demonstrates substantial assessment practice across design and release cycles, with clear engineering follow-through."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Presents security assessment as a well-developed skill, including structured methods, attacker-oriented analysis, and evidence of applying findings in real systems."}]},{"name":"Algorithmic problem solving","description":"Strength of evidence that the candidate uses data structures and algorithms to solve performance or correctness problems.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Gives no evidence of algorithmic depth."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Claims algorithmic ability in general terms without a concrete example."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Supports algorithmic ability with one clear example of improving a system through structure or algorithm choice."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows strong and current algorithmic practice through meaningful examples that changed system behavior or scalability."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Demonstrates standout algorithmic fluency with examples that turn difficult bottlenecks or heuristics into clean, tractable solutions."}]},{"name":"System ownership","description":"Extent to which the letter conveys end-to-end ownership of designing, building, operating, or maintaining systems.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Describes participation more than ownership, with little sense of leading design or long-term responsibility."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Shows responsibility for parts of systems but limited evidence of end-to-end ownership."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Conveys clear ownership of specific tools, services, or workflows from implementation through use."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows repeated end-to-end ownership, including architecture decisions, operational constraints, or maintenance responsibility."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Projects strong technical ownership by describing systems personally architected, constrained, operated, and improved over time."}]},{"name":"Security motivation","description":"Strength and seriousness of the applicant's stated motivation for doing security engineering rather than generic software work.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Expresses only generic interest in the role or company, with little sign of a real security-specific motive."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Shows some interest in security impact but does not articulate why the domain matters personally."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Gives a clear personal reason for wanting security engineering work."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Articulates a thoughtful security philosophy or motivation that feels specific and credible."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Communicates deep, convincing security motivation, showing the applicant sees protective engineering as a deliberate career direction rather than a convenient next job."}]},{"name":"Developer enablement orientation","description":"Extent to which the letter frames security work as helping developers do the secure thing easily and by default.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Does not discuss developer-facing enablement or secure defaults."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Hints at helping other engineers but without a clear developer-enablement perspective."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows a recognizable belief that good security tooling should reduce friction for developers."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Clearly emphasizes secure defaults, reduced manual burden, or making the right path easy for busy teams."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Makes developer enablement a core theme, explicitly treating security as a product for engineers rather than as policing or paperwork."}]},{"name":"Scale leverage orientation","description":"Extent to which the letter shows excitement for foundation-layer work that multiplies impact across a large organization.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Says little about scale, leverage, or foundation-level impact."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions large scale or broad impact briefly but without much substance."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows a clear interest in work whose benefits extend beyond a single product or team."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Persuasively frames the role as high-leverage infrastructure work that expands a security team's reach."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Repeatedly demonstrates a strong capacity-multiplying mindset, emphasizing organization-wide leverage, foundational infrastructure, or fleet-wide protection."}]},{"name":"Security collaboration orientation","description":"Extent to which the letter shows readiness to work closely with security specialists and partner teams.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Does not mention collaboration with security engineers or related partner teams."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Uses generic teamwork language without showing how the applicant works with security specialists."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Acknowledges partnering with security engineers or adjacent teams as part of the role."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Clearly values close collaboration with security specialists and presents it as a productive way of working."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Makes cross-functional security collaboration a central part of the case, showing eagerness both to contribute engineering depth and to learn from security experts."}]},{"name":"Role alignment specificity","description":"How precisely the letter connects the applicant's background to this job's stated responsibilities and preferred qualifications.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Reads mostly as a generic software or security application with little direct mapping to the posting."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Shows some relevant overlap but leaves important responsibilities or preferred skills unaddressed."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Covers several major requirements or responsibilities with reasonable directness."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Maps the applicant's background tightly to the role, touching most of the important responsibilities and preferred skills."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Feels custom-built for the posting, directly aligning past work with Go backends, Python agents, security automation, vulnerability handling, and collaboration with security engineers."}]},{"name":"Evidence specificity","description":"How concrete and observable the supporting evidence is behind the letter's claims.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Relies mostly on broad assertions, adjectives, or aspirations with little concrete supporting detail."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Includes a few specifics but still leaves most claims unsupported or generic."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Regularly uses concrete examples, named systems, or observable outcomes to back up claims."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Supports major claims with specific technical examples that make the applicant's contribution believable."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Consistently grounds the case in vivid, concrete evidence, including particular systems, constraints, workflows, or outcomes that make the application highly credible."}]},{"name":"Narrative cohesion","description":"How well the letter is organized into a clear, persuasive story rather than a loose list of facts.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Feels choppy, list-like, or poorly connected, making the case hard to follow."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Has a basic structure but weak transitions or an uneven argumentative flow."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Reads coherently from opening through closing, with a recognizable throughline."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Builds a strong and well-sequenced case in which each paragraph advances the application."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Delivers an especially cohesive narrative, with a memorable opening, purposeful progression, and a strong sense of why this candidate fits this role now."}]},{"name":"Writing mechanics","description":"Quality of spelling, grammar, and sentence-level polish in the letter.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Contains frequent errors or awkward phrasing that distract from the content and undermine professionalism."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Has multiple noticeable mechanical issues, though the meaning remains understandable."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Has some minor errors or clumsy spots but is generally readable and professional."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Is clean and polished, with only rare minor slips."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Is essentially error-free and professionally polished throughout."}]},{"name":"Open source stewardship","description":"Extent to which the letter shows sustained contribution to or maintenance of open-source software.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Gives no evidence of open-source contribution or maintenance."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions open source only casually or as a user, without clear contribution evidence."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows occasional upstream fixes or contributions to projects the applicant uses."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Demonstrates meaningful external contribution, such as repeated patches or active maintenance responsibilities."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows strong stewardship through maintaining a public project, handling reviews and releases, or supporting an external contributor community."}]},{"name":"Personal project rigor","description":"Strength of evidence from self-directed technical projects outside core job responsibilities.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Gives no personal project evidence or mentions only something trivial without technical depth."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions a small personal build with limited complexity or relevance."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows a complete side project that demonstrates initiative and some technical substance."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Describes a substantial personal systems project that tackles nontrivial engineering concerns."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Presents an ambitious self-driven project that confronts hard systems problems such as distribution, failover, recovery, or delivery guarantees."}]},{"name":"Self-driven security development","description":"Extent to which the letter shows ongoing security skill-building outside ordinary job duties.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Gives no sign of security development outside normal work experience."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Shows only light or implicit extra effort toward security learning."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Includes a baseline external signal such as occasional CTF participation or a foundational security certification."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows sustained extra commitment through serious practice, strong competition results, or purposeful certification choices."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Demonstrates exceptional self-driven security development, such as advanced hands-on certification or consistently strong competitive offensive-security performance."}]}]}
